newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan threatens to seize Taiwan, HK protest boats.
newsitem.headline: Japan threatens to seize Taiwan, HK protest boats.

text.p: Japan threatened on Monday to seize protest boats from Taiwan and Hong Kong if activists aboard the vessels tried to land on a disputed island chain in the East China Sea.
"The Japanese government will take appropriate measures to block (the activists) from landing on the islands," top government spokesman Seiroku Kajiyama told a news conference.
Asked if the measures could include seizing the ships, Kajiyama replied: "Yes, that's right."
"As we have repeatedly said, the islands are Japan's territory and they are effectively controlled by Japan," Kajiyama said.
"Therefore, landing on the islands would constitute a violation of Japan's law," he added.

The Japanese coastguard deployed about 60 patrol boats on Monday to prevent a flotilla of about 20 protest vessels from Taiwan and Hong Kong approaching the disputed island chain, called the Senkakus in Japanese and the Diaoyus in Chinese.
